scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:rules: JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21} PATH=${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21}/bin:$PATH firebase --project proveit-test emulators:exec --only firestore "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:e2e: JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21} PATH=${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21}/bin:$PATH firebase --project proveit-test emulators:exec --only auth,firestore "npm run test:e2e:run"
scripts.test:e2e:run: FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 tsx tests/e2e/seed.ts && FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 playwright test
